title: About — UpSmith
text: UpSmith is built in Dallas for the home-services operators powering America. We make software that puts dollars on your P&L — that's the whole job. About — UpSmith AI Profit Engine Product Customers Integrations About Pricing Sign in Book a demo About UpSmith We build for the operators who keep the lights on. HVAC, plumbing, and electrical move $600B a year and keep this country running. The trades deserve software that respects that — built by people who have been inside your shop, not Silicon Valley. Why we exist Demand isn't the problem. Capacity is. Every great shop owner we have ever met has the same complaint: the phone won't stop ringing, the database is full of customers they will never get to, and they can't hire CSRs fast enough — even if they wanted to pay for them. UpSmith was started because none of the existing software addressed that. Dashboards don't book jobs. AI chatbots don't close estimates. And nobody was building a tool that actually moved a service business' P&L. So we built one — for HVAC, plumbing, and electrical operators. What we believe Four principles. No exceptions. Trades-first, software-second. We are not retrofitting a generic chatbot. Every line of product gets shaped by HVAC, plumbing, and electrical shops in the field. If it doesn't make an owner's business run better, we don't ship it. Operator P&L, not vanity metrics. Engagement, sessions, MAU — none of it matters if your bank balance doesn't move. We ship to the line that ends up on your tax return. Real dollars on your P&L are the only scoreboard we play to. Honest AI. No tricks. Our AI identifies itself. It hands off to humans when it should. It never lies about being human. Your customers stay your customers — we just help you talk to all of them. Built for the long haul. Home services has been around for 100 years and isn't going anywhere. We are building the software layer that the best operators run on for the next 30 years. Get in touch Built in Dallas. # Wyatt Smith 

Founder & CEO

Wyatt Smith has a diverse work experience spanning numerous industries. Wyatt is currently the Founder & CEO of UpSmith, a position they have held since November 2021. Prior to this, they worked as a Fellow at On Deck from February 2021 to October 2021. Before that, Wyatt held a significant role at Uber where they served as the Head of Business Development for Elevate, Uber's aerial ridesharing business unit. During their time at Uber from 2017 to March 2021, Wyatt led successful efforts to catalyze over $5 billion in industry investments and form partnerships to accelerate the global electric air taxi market. Wyatt played a key role in securing a deal with Joby Aviation, which listed on the NYSE in August 2021 at a valuation of $6 billion, including a significant stake for Uber. Prior to their role at Uber, Wyatt worked as a Consultant at McKinsey & Company from 2015 to 2017. Wyatt also has experience in the education sector, having worked as a High School Social Studies Teacher for Teach for America from 2011 to 2013. Before that, they served as a Michael B. text:

# $10 million to help trades companies grow.

We’ve raised $10 million in new capital to power the people who power America.

At UpSmith, we’re betting that the biggest winners of AI will be the electricians, plumbers, and HVAC techs who keep our country running.

We started UpSmith with a focus on upskilling a new generation of builders. AI accelerated our work by unlocking technology for trades companies to gain more profitability and grow faster.

Today, we’re building an AI profit engine for the trades. Our AI agents give insights, answer calls, book jobs, close estimates, renew memberships, and bring back customers who went quiet. Companies across the country rely on it: HomeTown Services recovered 5,000+ jobs from unsold estimates this year. Five Star Home Services cut cancellations 34%.
